summary: Suzano S.A. filed a Form 6-K enclosing a Material Fact (the Brazilian equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) dated November 5, 2026, updating guidance rather than announcing any transaction. The company estimates FY2026 net debt to close below US$14.0 billion at an assumed BRL/USD rate of R$5.40, with unchanged targets of US$11.0 billion net debt and sub-2.5x leverage across 2027-2028, excluding effects of the July 1, 2026 Arbex acquisition. Average 2026 pulp cash cost guidance rose to roughly R$825/tonne from R$800 on higher FX and Brent assumptions. No deal terms; watch leverage trajectory.
